articles.title: COP31 deal draft foreshadows difficult route to consensus
articles.description: COP31 negotiators in Turkey released a draft agreement on Monday to advance talks on fossil fuels and climate finance before this week's deadline. The pressure to reach a deal is intense after a year of environmental challenges including catastrophic glacier flooding in Nepal and European wildfires, even as global conflict and cost-of-living protests distract leaders from climate action.

articles.title: Russia says intercepted over 1,300 Ukrainian drones in a major attack
articles.description: Russia intercepted 1,336 drones launched by Ukraine, Russia’s Defense Ministry said Monday, in what was the most claimed downings since Moscow’s all-out invasion of its neighbor nearly five years ago. Russia, meanwhile, has battered Ukrainian civilian areas with relentless strikes that seek to choke the economy and break public morale, in attacks President Volodymyr Zelensky said were made possible ⁠partly due to restrictions on Ukraine's use of SpaceX's Starshield service.

articles.title: Xi, Trump and Putin to discuss 'world peace' at Shenzhen summit, China says

The meeting is expected to happen on Thursday on the sidelines of a summit of Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) leaders.

articles.title: Iran blocks UN nuclear site visits until war ends
articles.description: Iran's foreign ministry on Monday said that it would block the International Atomic Energy Agency's access to its damaged nuclear facilities until stated conditions for permanently ending the war have been met by the US. The ministry's statement follows calls for the UN watchdog to resume inspections of nuclear sites, which have been suspended since last year's 12-day war with Israel.

articles.title: Francophonie summit avoids 'major disaster' after clash over leadership
articles.description: A summit of French-speaking nations attended by France's Emmanuel Macron postponed the election of a new chief Monday after a row between African neighbours the Democratic Republic of Congo and Rwanda. The postponement appears to have staved off a threatened walkout by DR Congo, avoiding what would have been a "major disaster", says France 24's Philip Turle.

articles.title: Estonia to close Russian border crossings after attempted arson attack on drone ‌maker

articles.title: French film star Depardieu drops appeal against sexual conviction
articles.description: French film star Gérard Depardieu on Monday dropped his appeal against a conviction for sexually assaulting two women during the filming of a movie in 2021 and issued "sincere apologies" for his past behaviour on set. "For a long time on film sets, I hid behind provocation and ribald humour," Depardieu, 77, said in the statement, withdrawing his appeal on the day it was set to go to trial. "I believed my remarks and some of my gestures would be without consequences" for those involved, he said.
